title: Memory Care Suite Changes and Annual Rate Increases
content:
A Memory Care Residency Agreement resident may move to another suite at the family's request, and the monthly rate of a continuing residency increases only within the limits below.

## Clause

1. **Suite change.** A family-requested suite change moves the resident to the tier with another suite type and the same care program, at the monthly rate of the new tier from the date of possession of the new suite, and the suite change fee is charged once. A companion suite may be chosen only while a bed is available within its limit of 2 residents.
2. **Status for a suite change.** Suite changes may be recorded only while the residency is in active status, as shown on the residency record.
3. **Rate increases.** The monthly rate of a continuing residency increases at most once in any 12-month period, by no more than 8.5 percent, after at least 60 days of written notice.

## Suite changes available within each care program

| Care program | Suite types offered | Possible family-requested moves |
|---|---|---|
| Essential | Companion, private | Companion to private; private to companion (bed permitting) |
| Enhanced | Companion, private | Companion to private; private to companion (bed permitting) |
| Advanced | Private, deluxe | Private to deluxe; deluxe to private |

The care program never changes with a suite change.

## Status test

| Residency status | Suite change may be recorded |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| Pending admission, on leave, notice given, vacated, closed or cancelled | No |

## Rate increase ceiling: worked figure (hypothetical rate)

A continuing residency's hypothetical monthly rate is 8000.00. The largest permitted single annual increase is 8.5 percent of it, 680.00, so the increased rate may be at most 8680.00, after at least 60 days of written notice, and no second increase may fall within the same 12-month period.

## Basis Q&A

**May a suite change be recorded while the resident is in hospital on a recorded absence?** No; the residency is then on leave, and suite changes are recorded only while it is active.
